pass_checks: No clipped body text, overlapping columns, broken glyphs, or missing figures were observed.
The two pipeline/evidence-design figures are sharp, consistently styled, and legible at normal review zoom.
Section hierarchy, margins, citations, and references render consistently with the AAAI template.

findings.issue: Several wide result and diagnostic tables are reduced to a very small font. Table 1 is difficult to scan, and Tables 3 and 4 are effectively unreadable without substantial zoom.
findings.review_consequence: The evidence cannot be efficiently checked from the paper, so important task/condition differences are hidden rather than communicated.

findings.issue: Non-reference external-evidence material appears on page 8 even though the source comments state a seven-page non-reference limit. Both tables on this page contain only pending placeholders.
findings.review_consequence: This is a page-limit risk and spends a full page on protocol placeholders rather than completed evidence.

findings.issue: Float placement creates large unused regions: the Conclusion occupies only the left column on page 6, pages 7 and 8 contain sparse floated material, and the references occupy only the left portion of page 9.
findings.review_consequence: The manuscript reads as mechanically accumulated tables rather than a deliberately prioritized evidence narrative.

scope_note: This visual review reports the rendered state only and makes no manuscript edits.
